Title: Vikram and the Family

Cast

1. Vikram - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Suresh - 38 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The ghat - Day

[Vikram stands on the ghat. Suresh stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vikram drowns in the river.]

Suresh: "We will never forget you."
